task: List 20 English verbs. For each, name the layer 5 outer verb (cycle, add, invert, compare, emit, absorb, filter, order, seek, wait, bound) and whether order would change the form. Write one JSON object per verb into workspace language/verbs.jsonl.
List 20 English nouns that name a structure (array, bag, tree, queue, stack, map, set, file, sensor, clock). Map each to a layer 5 verb it is the object of. Append to language/nouns.jsonl.

From the verbs and nouns already written, emit 10 compositions where order matters (cycle-add vs add-cycle). Write language/compositions.jsonl. Mark any pair the model claims is commutative as discard.
Assemble language/graph.json in the galaxy shape: nodes with id, rank, kind, label, english; links with source, target, rel. Rank 5 verbs, rank 4 forms, rank 3 words.
